$comment: Managed by copilot-governance. Do not edit this file downstream.
Registers the prompt interception kernel as a VS Code Copilot UserPromptSubmit hook.
The hook command runs with the workspace root as its working directory, so the
path below is workspace-relative. Node accepts forward slashes on every platform,
so no per-OS command variants are needed.
If node is unavailable the command exits non-zero, which the hook runtime treats
as a non-blocking warning: prompts pass through ungoverned rather than failing.
